verified_records.claim: Injected movement intent drives the player left/right on the frozen Transform surface, and releasing the input (move_dir=0) zeroes the velocity so the x coordinate stops changing (no inertia drift).

execution_records.observation: bevy_inject_move {dir:1,level:true} at frame 509 (accepted), bevy_wait_frames -> frame_after 524, then bevy_player_transform at frame 525 reports x=54.39280319213867 vs reading frame 505 x=0.0 (Velocity.x=200.0); the game's own FrameCounter (hof_game::contract::FrameCounter frames=525) is the frame stamp, not a poll count.

reading frame 607 x=264.606689453125, then bevy_inject_move {dir:-1,level:true} at frame 609, wait -> 624, reading frame 625 x=210.5236663818359 with Velocity.x=-200.0: the negative direction moves the player left.

after bevy_inject_move {dir:0,level:true} at frame 627, bevy_player_transform reads x=203.7618865966797 at frame 635 and x=203.7618865966797 again at frame 647 (12 frames apart), with Velocity.x=0.0 in both payloads: the player stops, no residual drift.

execution_records.observation: bevy_coin_counter at frame 501 -> {coins: 0}; after bevy_inject_move {dir:1,level:true} (frame 539) and bevy_wait_frames (->550), bevy_coin_counter at frame 535 -> {coins: 1} and stays 1 at frames 535, 551, 567, 581, 595. verified_records.claim: A one-way win condition exists: when the player reaches the goal the reflectable WinFlag flips false -> true and never returns to false, read at a frame where the player is standing at the goal's reachable x.

execution_records.observation: bevy_win_flag readings: frame 503 -> won=false, frame 537 -> won=false, frame 553 -> won=true (after level move_dir=1 from frame 539), and stays true at frames 569, 583, 597. Raw reply payload {"value":{"won":true}}.

at the win frame 553 won=true, and bevy_player_transform at frame 555 reads x=115.60417938232422, y=-200.0 with Grounded.on_ground=true and Velocity.x=200.0: the player is standing on the ground plane at the goal's x, not falling.

verified_records.claim: Injected jump intent makes the player rise and then fall, and the arc ends back on the ground (a monotone fall alone would not count).

gap_records.claim: The coin counter can be driven past 1 by a second pickup (PRD P2 says the count increases on pickup, with no cap stated).
gap_records.player_impact: The player can only ever collect the single demonstrated coin; a level with a second pickable would be unverified, so a multi-coin run could silently not increment or could re-trigger on the same coin.
gap_records.recommended_update: Add a second coin at a distinct reachable x beyond the first and record a battery step reading CoinCounter 0 -> 1 -> 2 in one session.

gap_records.claim: The headless process stays alive and answering for a whole round (PRD section 4 startup rule), not merely for the 3.4 s deterministic battery.
gap_records.player_impact: If the process can exit after the short battery window, a longer play session would end with the game gone and no further input or reads possible.
gap_records.recommended_update: Persist a live liveness probe (bevy_health plus a bevy_player_transform frame reading) into .hoh/deterministic/raw/ late in the round so continued liveness is a citable record rather than an unrecorded probe.

preservation_constraints: Keep crate name hof_game and contract module hof_game::contract; do not rename or re-register the frozen type paths Player, Grounded, FrameCounter, CoinCounter, WinFlag, InputIntent, Velocity.

Keep RemotePlugin::default() + RemoteHttpPlugin::default() + ScheduleRunnerPlugin::run_loop(1/60) with the headless switch, so the endpoint 127.0.0.1:15702 is bound and the process does not exit after one frame.
Keep InputIntent level-triggered with per-frame clearing by the game, and keep every reading's frame field sourced from FrameCounter (never from a poll ordinal).
Keep the win write one-way (won=true is never reset) and the movement release setting Velocity.x to exactly 0.
update_targets: No change needed for P1/P3/P4/P5 behaviour; treat the observed x/y/coins/won traces as the regression baseline.
Add a second coin at a reachable x beyond the first (P2B).
Emit a persisted late-round liveness record (S1).
validation_requirements: Re-run the deterministic battery and require ok=true for e3_movement, e3_movement_left, e3_movement_release, e3_jump_arc, e3_grounded, e3_grounded_payload, e3_coin_counter, e3_win_flag and e3_win_position.
Movement: require x to increase with dir=1, decrease with dir=-1, and be byte-identical across two reads at least 10 frames apart after dir=0.
Jump: require the recorded arc to carry both rising and falling steps and to end back at the on-ground y, with Grounded true before take-off and false mid-flight.
Coin/win: require coins to be monotone non-decreasing and won to be one-way false -> true, read at a frame whose player x equals the goal x.
